title: Build an ASR training recipe
brief: Train byte-pair merges, perturb speed, mix noise at an SNR, pack length buckets, and schedule the learning rate.
hints: Count adjacent pairs on the symbols left after each merge. On cat/car/card, a count that stays on the original characters merges (a, r) second.
speed_perturb(x, 1.1) shortens the clip. The length is ceil(len(x) * 10 / 11), from resample_poly(x, 10, 11).
The noise gain is sqrt(P_clean / (P_noise * 10 ** (snr_db / 10))). The exponent is 10.
noam_lr multiplies d_model ** -0.5 by min(step ** -0.5, step * warmup ** -1.5). During the warmup the second term is smaller.
